observations: Photo 0 shows the retail packaging for a dry iron.
The box is branded 'Panasonic' with model 'NI-113EW'.
The box features a slogan 'It is your idea', which is not the standard Panasonic slogan ('Ideas for Life').
The box specifies 1000W power, non-stick coating, and an adjustable swivel cord.
The actual iron is not visible in the photo; only the box is shown.

risks.if_unproven: Priced as an empty box or missing item.

risks.proof: A clear photo of the rating plate on the iron itself.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic or counterfeit brand due to suspicious box slogan.
